title: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.
passage_1:
Dario Fenn (9:02 A.M.)
We need to confirm the venue for the yearly fundraising concert to raise funds for the senior citizen’s hospital. It’s only three months away.

Priya Sandhu (9:04 A.M.)
I thought we were reserving the Marlowe Room at the Riverside Assembly Hall? Everyone praised it last year.

Dario Fenn (9:05 A.M.)
I just got off a call with them. The building will be closed during the week of our concert. They have some refurbishment work scheduled.

Nora Kelleher (9:07 A.M.)
What a disaster! Can we move the date of the concert?

Priya Sandhu (9:08 A.M.)
Our keynote speaker and main sponsors are travelling in from abroad.

Nora Kelleher (9:10 A.M.)
OK, let’s find an alternative. What about the Larkspur Pavilion? It seats a similar number, and it’s within walking distance of the assembly hall.

Dario Fenn (9:11 A.M.)
Good idea. Nora, can you give them a call right away to make a reservation? While you do that, I’ll get in touch with the printers we used last year to check availability.
